integrity: The asymptotic constants are derived from the exact scalar eigenvalue equation. Numerical root solving is used only as a reproducibility check and not as evidence for the limit \(d\to\infty\).
scientific_limitations: The result is for the one-dimensional Neumann transverse truncation, not a complete finite-width asymptotic for the full surface Hamiltonian. It excludes the unbiased endpoint \(V_0=0\) from the displayed subcritical coefficient and gives asymptotic, not explicit uniform, remainder bounds.
title: Sharp Neumann-truncation asymptotics for a biased delta interface
